revision_note: v2 supersedes v1. Updated after ChatGPT review: the Unreal licence position is now recorded explicitly as Non-Engine Product output with no royalty, the seat-licence threshold and price are named, and the engine-bundled PCG/Mass plugin stack verified in Phase 1 is enumerated.
cost_law: The Director pays only for the Claude Code subscription and existing DeepSeek worker usage. Every entry below must have verified_cost_usd = 0 for our actual use, or the component must be removed.

unreal_license_position.our_output: Linear, non-interactive video published to YouTube.
unreal_license_position.reasoning: We ship no interactive product, no application, and nothing that relies on Unreal Engine code at runtime. The deliverable is a rendered video file. Under Epic's terms this is linear content, which carries NO Unreal royalty regardless of revenue.
unreal_license_position.royalty_rule_that_does_not_apply_to_us: The 5% royalty applies to off-the-shelf INTERACTIVE products past USD 1,000,000 lifetime gross. We ship no such product.

seat_license_exception.applies_to: Non-game commercial users (film, broadcast, simulation, archviz) at companies whose ANNUAL GROSS REVENUE exceeds the threshold below.
seat_license_exception.current_status: BELOW THRESHOLD — the Director is an individual creator far under USD 1,000,000 annual gross revenue. Unreal Engine is therefore free for this project today.
seat_license_exception.RECHECK_TRIGGER: If the Director's annual gross revenue from any source relevant to Epic's definition approaches or crosses USD 1,000,000, this licence MUST be re-evaluated before further production. This is the single re-check condition for the entire project.
seat_license_exception.confidence: HIGH on the no-royalty position for linear video. MEDIUM on the exact seat-licence wording: epicgames.com returns HTTP 403 to automated retrieval and no EULA text ships in the install, so the threshold and price come from Epic's published pricing announcement and consistent secondary reporting, not from primary licence text. DIRECTOR/CHATGPT VERIFICATION REQUESTED.

dependencies.name: City Sample (PCG)
dependencies.acquisition_status: CLAIMED to the Director's Fab library 2026-09-03. Download started the same day by the Director's one click; at the revision-5 build it was still constructing in the launcher vault (32 GB staged, project not yet created). NOT YET OPENED OR INSPECTED.
dependencies.decision: Phase 1 established that every plugin City Sample depends on is already enabled and working here, so City Sample supplies content and example graphs rather than capability. It is a 1 km dense city built from 18 interdependent PCG graphs; our world is 600 x 600 m. It stays a REFERENCE. See CITY_SAMPLE_PCG_COMPATIBILITY.md section 5 for the smallest-useful-subset plan.
dependencies.notes: Epic's 5.8 documentation confirms the PCG version needs no external software; the original 5.0 City Sample's Houdini dependency is gone. This keeps the project clear of any paid-tool pathway.
